title: Medical English 05-06
category: Medical & Dental Questions > Medical English Question

questions.question: Choose the correct English idiom for 'শাস্তি দেওয়া'।
questions.explanation: শাস্তি দেওয়া অর্থে bring to book এ phrase টি ব্যবহৃত হয়

questions.question: The virtuous (be) always happy. Which one of the followings is the correct verb for the one within the bracket?
questions.explanation: The + adjective বাক্যের শুরুতে subject হিসেবে বসলে, তা plural common Noun-কে Indicate করে এবং এর verb সর্বদা plural হয়।

questions.question: He lives .......... honest means.
questions.explanation: 'Live by' অর্থ কোনো উপায়ে জীবন ধারণ করা

questions.question: Which one of the following sentence is incorrect?
options: She was married with a rich man
The patient has died of cholera
The man was cured of his illness
I hope he will succeed in his work
questions.explanation: কারো সাথে বিয়ে হওয়া বোঝাতে marry to sb (somebody) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Choose the best indirect form of the following sentences: 'Do you know the way to the station?' She said to Mahin.
options: She asked Mahin whether he knew the way to the station
She asked Mahin whether he knows the way to the station
She ask Mahin of he knew the way to the station
She asks Mahin if he knows the way to the station
questions.explanation: Reporting verb past হলে Indirect speech-এ reported speech present থেকে past Indefinite-এ রূপান্তরিত হয়।

questions.question: What is the singular form of the word 'appendices'?
'Though Bangladesh is blessed with rivers it drought occasionally.
questions.explanation: It third person singular হওয়ায় verb-এর পরে s/es (faces- মুখোমুখী হওয়া) বসবে।

questions.question: Find out the correct English translation for the following sentence: 'সকাল থেকে গুড়ি গুড়ি বৃষ্টি হচ্ছে'।
options: It has been raining from morning
It has been drizzling since morning
questions.explanation: বাক্যটি present perfect continuous হবে। Drizzle অর্থ গুড়ি গুড়ি বা খুব হালকাভাবে বৃষ্টি হওয়া। নির্দিষ্ট সময় বা point of time উল্লেখ থাকায় বাক্যটি present perfect continuous tense এ হবে।

questions.question: Select the best English translation for the following sentences: 'খাবার সময় আমাদের মনে রাখতে হবে যে আমরা শুধু ক্ষুধা নিবৃত করতে অথবা পেট ভরানোর জন্য খাই না'।
options: While eat food, we should bear in mind that we do not eat just to satisfies hunger or to fill the belly.
While eat food, we should bear in mind that we do not eat just to satisfy hunger or to fill the belly
While eating food, we should bear in mind that we do not eat just to satisfy hunger or to fill the belly
While eat food, we should bears in mind that we do not eat just to satisfy hunger or to fill the belly
questions.explanation: While-এর immediate পরে verb বসলে, সেটি ing যুক্ত হয়।

questions.question: A Synonym for 'Ascent' is-
questions.explanation: Ascent শব্দের অর্থ উপরে ওঠা। এর কিছু সমার্থক শব্দ হলো: jump, climb, rise, scaling, conquest Jot down অর্থ লেখা বা বর্ণনা করা; further অর্থ আরও; regress অর্থ পূর্বের অবস্থায় ফিরে যাওয়া।

questions.question: Select the best English translation for the following sentence: 'কোন মানুষ একা বাস করতে পারে না'।
Change the following sentence into indirect speech: Amin said, 'I have been working since 9 am.'
options: Amin said that he is working since 9 am
Amin said that he has been working since 9 am
Amin said that he has worked till 9 am
Amin said that he had been working since 9 am
questions.explanation: Reporting verb past হলে Indirect-এর present perfect continuous tense যুক্ত বাক্যটি past perfect continuous tense-এ রূপান্তরিত হয়।

questions.question: 'If she had studied harder, ____'
questions.explanation: If clause past perfect হলে, main clause-এ sub + would have + PP হবে। যদি সে আরো কঠোর ভাবে পড়াশুনা করত, তবে সে ভাল করত।

questions.question: The antonym for 'dull' is-
questions.explanation: Dull অর্থ নিরস, একঘেঁয়ে (monotonous)-এর বিপরীত interesting অর্থ মজাদায়ক/ আনন্দদায়ক।

questions.question: You need not _______ the secret from me'.
questions.explanation: Hold back অর্থ গোপন/ অজানা রাখা; hold off দূরে রাখা; hold in সংযত রাখা; hold on অপেক্ষা করা। বাক্যটির বাংলা অর্থ: গূঢ় বা গোপন বিষয়টি আমার কাছে লুকানোর দরকার নেই।
